import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    t = 1  # while loop runs once
    while t > 0:
        t -= 1
        n = int(next(it))  # not used
        a = [0, 0, 0]
        b = [0, 0, 0]
        a[0] = int(next(it))  # a1
        a[2] = int(next(it))  # a3
        a[1] = int(next(it))  # a2
        b[0] = int(next(it))  # b1
        b[2] = int(next(it))  # b3
        b[1] = int(next(it))  # b2
        min_val = 0
        max_val = 0
        for i in range(3):
            max_val += min(a[i], b[(i + 2) % 3])
        for i in range(3):
            min_val += max(0, a[i] - (b[(i + 1) % 3] + b[i]))
        print(f"{min_val} {max_val}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
